verdict.rationale: Daytona documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with Daytona Sandboxes programmatically. The docs include an initialization step for supported agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf), and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: documented catalog of exposed MCP tools/operations and their depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent via the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Daytona Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI agents to interact with Daytona Sandboxes programmatically.
Initialize the MCP server with your preferred AI agent. Supported agents include Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf.
official MCP server documented at https://www.daytona.io/docs/mcp
